# Veritas Aescula Institute

> Veritas Aescula Institute (VAI) is a fully online school for students in Myanmar and across Southeast Asia who want to study medicine. It offers healthcare-focused OSSD, GED and IGCSE O Level programmes, and ALMA, a fast-track Pearson Edexcel International A Level programme in Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics for medical aspirants.

## Programmes

- [ALMA — A Levels for Med Aspirants](https://veritasaescula.com/#alma): An 18-month, fully online, fast-track programme in Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level (IAL) Biology (YBI11), Chemistry (YCH11) and Mathematics (YMA01), covering the full specification and the same official Pearson exams. The first cohort runs from January 2027 to June 2028. Students sit IAS exams in the January 2028 series and apply to medical school with predicted scores built on those exams; final IA2 exams are in May/June 2028. O Level and Grade 11 finishers enter directly; Grade 10 and GED finishers enter after a Diagnostic Placement Exam and Structured Admissions Interview, with a 6-month Pre-A Level Bridging Course if required. Teaching is online; the official Pearson exams are sat in person — in Myanmar at centres assigned by the British Council and at Pearson centres, and in Thailand at the Pearson centre in Bangkok.
- [Program Highlights](https://veritasaescula.com/#programs): The four programmes side by side — Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD), GED, IGCSE O Level and ALMA.
- [IGCSE O Level to Medical School](https://veritasaescula.com/#igcse-pathway): Why IGCSE O Level alone is rarely enough for direct Year 1 medical entry, and how students bridge to a full secondary diploma.

## Admissions

- [How to Apply](https://veritasaescula.com/how-to-apply.html): The enrolment steps and the VAI Diagnostic Exam, a placement and scholarship assessment in English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
- [OSSD Course Planner](https://veritasaescula.com/course-planner.html): An interactive planner for choosing OSSD Grade 12 courses by stream and seeing which university pathways they open.

## About

- [Success Stories](https://veritasaescula.com/success-stories.html): VAI graduates and the medical universities that accepted them.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://veritasaescula.com/#faq): Answers about the OSSD, GED and IGCSE O Level programmes.
- [ALMA FAQ](https://veritasaescula.com/#faq-alma): Answers about ALMA's subjects, pace, practical assessment, entry routes and application timeline.
